title: 独立 grader 与分层任务集
dataKind: executed tests with a real child process (no model calls)
code: integration/acceptance-runner.js — fixed external checks, argv form runs without a shell, treeFingerprint reused from work-packet.js, acceptanceFiles digested before/after AND against the frozen baseline
test/benchmarks/session-strategies/ — README + example-local-fix task (broken start, reference fix, fixed grader)

referencePasses.observed: the example task's reference fix passes the fixed grader (7/7) through a real child process

brokenStartFails.observed: the start state fails the same grader without throwing; the verdict reports the failed check

wrongPatchFails.observed: a plausible wrong patch passes 1-3 but fails 7/7, so the grader is not a happy-path test

graderTamperDetected.observed: editing an acceptanceFiles entry after baseline, or rewriting the grader during the run, yields OMC/ACCEPTANCE-TAMPERED

forbidChanges.observed: a delivered change outside writeScope is reported by verifyDelivered against the frozen baseline; no baseline means no silent pass

fingerprintStable.observed: two runs over the same tree produce the same fingerprint; a real edit moves it

splitNoLeak.observed: deterministicSplit keeps a whole family in one split, is salt-stable, and notes singleton families

argvNotShell.observed: the injected subprocess service receives a literal argv plus cwd and env, never a shell string

taskSet.note: a task set large enough for R08 does not exist yet; only the wiring and one real task ship here

boundaries: the runner proves behaviour only; subjective quality still needs a rubric and blind review, and a model grader is never the sole truth
tamper protection covers only declared acceptanceFiles; without declarations the verdict carries a warning that nothing protects the grading
the acceptance definition must live outside the worker's write scope; forbidChanges only detects changes against a caller-frozen baseline
notCovered: a task set with enough families for a 30-task confirmation run
model-assisted grading calibration against human samples
